verdict.rationale: Community reports say Postmark has an official MCP server (postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp, repo ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp). That would let users drive sending and other operations through natural language, but only via an external AI agent or client. The probed llms.txt also gives agents task-oriented guidance, though it is reference material rather than a natural-language interface. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the MCP server's tools and scope, a native in-product natural-language interface, and hands-on corroboration that the official server works.
